description:
As a customer, I want to complete my order.

* The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

criteria.text: The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

cases.title: User finishes checkout and sees a confirmation
cases.preconditions: A user account exists and is logged in: <a user account that can place an order>. The cart contains <at least one purchasable item>. Any data the checkout form requires is available to the tester: <the details the checkout form asks for>.
steps: Open the cart containing <at least one purchasable item>.
Fill in whatever the checkout form asks for, using <the details the checkout form asks for>.
Finish checkout by confirming the order.
cases.expected: Checkout completes and a confirmation is shown to the user. The exact wording and contents of the confirmation are not specified in the story.
